SELECT t.name AS merchant_name,
       d.review_count AS dec2025_review_count,
       d.avg_rating AS dec2025_avg_rating,
       d.pct_1_2_star AS dec2025_pct_1_2_star,
       j.avg_rating AS jan_to_nov_2025_avg_rating,
       ROUND(d.avg_rating - j.avg_rating, 2) AS rating_change_pts
FROM tenants t
JOIN (
  SELECT p.tenant_id,
         COUNT(*) AS review_count,
         ROUND(AVG(pr.rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
         ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN pr.rating <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_1_2_star
  FROM product_reviews pr
  JOIN products p ON pr.product_id = p.id
  WHERE pr.is_approved = true
    AND pr.created_at >= DATE '2025-12-01'
    AND pr.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY p.tenant_id
) d ON d.tenant_id = t.id
JOIN (
  SELECT p.tenant_id,
         ROUND(AVG(pr.rating), 2) AS avg_rating
  FROM product_reviews pr
  JOIN products p ON pr.product_id = p.id
  WHERE pr.is_approved = true
    AND pr.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND pr.created_at < DATE '2025-12-01'
  GROUP BY p.tenant_id
) j ON j.tenant_id = t.id
WHERE t.industry = 'Home & Living'
ORDER BY rating_change_pts ASC, d.review_count DESC

note: Both dec2025_avg_rating and jan_to_nov_2025_avg_rating are rounded to 2 decimals before computing rating_change_pts, since the report is meant to show the rounded values a reader would compare on the page; merchants with 0 reviews in Jan-Nov 2025 are excluded via the inner join since no baseline exists for them.
